title: 279. Restore IP Addresses

examples.explanation: Both splits use all digits with each octet in range and no bad leading zeros.
Each single zero is a valid octet.
Five ways to cut the six digits into valid octets.

hints: Backtrack over at most 4 parts, trying lengths 1-3 at each step and pruning when the remainder cannot fill the remaining parts.
Reject a part with a leading zero unless it is exactly "0", and reject values above 255.
Only record an address when 4 parts are placed and every character is consumed.
